title: Etale cover retaining finitely presented constant module models
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $\Lambda$ a discrete commutative ring and $F$ a pro-etale sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules. Assume $F$ is locally constant and admits a pro-etale covering with finitely presented constant module models. Then there is an etale scheme covering $\mathcal U$ indexed in the universe of $X$ such that, for every index $i$, the scheme inverse image of $F$ on $\mathcal U_i$ is a constant sheaf with a finitely presented $\Lambda$-module model. The sites are [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], inverse images are [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], constants are [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and module sheaves use [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

proof.text: Convert slice trivializations on the given covering to scheme inverse-image trivializations, using the weakly etale slice equivalence and constant comparison.

Apply proEtale_model_type_opens to these actual models. For every model choose its open isomorphism-type locus. Base change the original covering to that open. A point on a nonempty overlap identifies its model with the chosen one. On empty overlap schemes both sheaves are uniquely isomorphic. These give a uniform model cover on the open locus.

Finite presentation implies finite generation, so apply the uniform finite-type model theorem on each locus. Choose a locus containing each point of X and assemble its etale coverings, indexed by pairs of a point and a local cover index. Composition of inverse images preserves the original chosen models and their finite presentation.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleCover_of_finitelyPresentedModels
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (Λ : Type u) [CommRing Λ]
    (F : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)))
    (hF : IsFinitePresentationProEtaleLocalSystem X Λ F) :
    ∃ 𝒰 : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.etalePrecoverage X, ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀,
      ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ),
        Module.FinitePresentation (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ) M ∧
          Nonempty ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) (𝒰.f i)).obj F ≅
            (constantSheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (𝒰.X i))
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ))).obj M)
